# Fixture Forms and Offices Catalogue

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software tests; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 Forms

Form PX-101 is the standard application form for domestic applicants. Form PX-204 is the application form for international applicants. Form PX-118 is used to renew a residence permit.

## 2 Offices

The Permit Processing Office (PPO) handles all residence permit applications. The PPO is closed on public holidays.
